_comment: Pinned tool versions for the advisor loop. Re-pin quarterly, not on every release. Re-verify SHA256s when bumping. cosign-keyless tools verify the SIGNED CHECKSUMS file (not a per-tarball sidecar — those don't exist), then sha256-match the tarball against it.

trivy._asset_naming: trivy uses Linux-64bit / Linux-ARM64 (capital L, no underscore-amd64). Template hard-codes amd64; templatize when arm64 CI is added.
trivy._cosign_note: trivy signs the checksums file as a Sigstore bundle (.sigstore.json); verify with --bundle --new-bundle-format. Identity is goreleaser-built, matched by regexp.

syft._cosign_note: anchore signs the checksums file; the signing identity is the release workflow on refs/heads/main (NOT the version tag).

cosign._comment: Chicken-and-egg: cosign verifies the others, so it can't verify itself with cosign on a clean runner. Pin its release SHA256 instead; install-verify installs cosign FIRST so the cosign-keyless tools can be verified.

gitleaks._asset_naming: gitleaks publishes linux_x64 / linux_arm64 (not amd64). Template hard-codes x64; templatize when arm64 CI is added.
gitleaks._comment: Gitleaks doesn't sign releases with cosign; SHA256 captured 2026-05-30 from the official release asset.

semgrep._version_note: Bumped from 1.95.0 on 2026-05-19. 1.95.0 ships with an opentelemetry-instrumentation version that's incompatible with Python 3.12 on Ubuntu 24.04 GHA runners — pipx install succeeds but `semgrep` itself crashes at import. 1.163.0 ships a fixed dep set.
semgrep._todo: pip-hash not yet enforced (pipx lacks --require-hashes); relies on PyPI TLS + version pin. Follow-up: install via `pip install --require-hashes` with pinned wheel hashes.

tfsec._comment: tfsec is archived/unsigned; SHA256 captured 2026-05-30 from the official release asset.

scorecard._version_note: v5.0.0 was never released; ossf jumped from 5.x prereleases to 5.5.0 (2026-04-23). Pinned at 5.5.0 on 2026-05-19.
scorecard._comment: scorecard publishes SLSA provenance (multiple.intoto.jsonl), NOT a cosign-signed checksums sidecar — so the cosign-keyless path can't verify it. Interim: pin SHA256 (captured 2026-05-30). Follow-up: verify the SLSA provenance with slsa-verifier at install time.

zap._comment: OWASP ZAP runs as a container. Pin by digest, not tag. Re-verify quarterly. Use docker pull zaproxy/zap-stable && docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' to capture the current digest.

_notes_on_pin_me: Entries marked 'PINME' are placeholders (pipx tools only). Run install-verify.sh --capture-hashes to populate them from the release artifact actually downloaded.
cosign-keyless tools (syft/grype/trivy) need no SHA256 pin: their tarball is checked against the cosign-VERIFIED checksums file at install time.
Each sha256 pin runs through a quarterly re-verify cycle. The CI installer refuses to proceed if a SHA256 doesn't match the pin.
